question:
Identify the part containing a grammatical or structural error:

No sooner he had arrived than the meeting started.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase **"he had arrived"**. The auxiliary verb "did" is required for the correct construction of the sentence.
 
• The expression "No sooner" is always followed by an auxiliary verb (e.g., "did") to maintain proper syntax.
 
• The correct structure should be "**No sooner did he arrive** than the meeting started."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"No sooner **did he arrive** than the meeting started."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "No error"** – This is incorrect because there is an error in the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "No sooner"** – This part is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "than the meeting started"** – This part is also correct and does not require any changes.
